def can_reconstruct_words(N, lengths):
    # Create a list to store the words
    words = []
    
    # Create a set to keep track of used prefixes
    used_prefixes = set()
    
    for length in lengths:
        # Try to find a valid word of the given length
        found = False
        for i in range(2 ** length):
            word = bin(i)[2:].zfill(length)
            # Check if the word is not a prefix of any previously used word
            if all(word[:j] not in used_prefixes for j in range(1, length)):
                words.append(word)
                used_prefixes.add(word)
                found = True
                break
        
        # If no valid word was found, return "NO"
        if not found:
            return "NO"
    
    # If all words were successfully found, return "YES" followed by the words
    return "YES\n" + "\n".join(words)
